body: Acknowledged. I checked only for a running lane and GitHub's reviewDecision; I missed the AIDA approvals and the #4132 pin. From now on the product seat moves no PR head; I'll ask you instead. Note #4122 and #4124 were also updated at 19:54; if either was approved, it needs a re-review too. Filed the guard as a bug so this can't happen under any vendor: aida commands refuse to move an approved or train-pinned head, and aida pr state (which timed out for me just now) shows the pin.
subject: Ack: my mistake on #4117/#4126 update-branch; will not move PR heads again
